objective: 从专业教程研究出条件化部件宽度与字内负空间关系，验证未知词的字形结果是否获得专业美感。

source_provenance.status: Both full accessible text sources reviewed and mechanisms paraphrased; editor source draft paths and historical author action are not available for R9.
source_provenance.extracted_general_principle: Left/right components should be allocated according to structural density with deliberate negative space, but source texts do NOT give our numerical cutoff/ratio parameters.
source_provenance.non_source_parameters: 5/8/9 thresholds and 28/24/19.5 percent are engineering hypotheses frozen before target data read, NOT author supplied methods.

experiment.surface: Existing connected Figma project as independent research diagnostic board, NOT as creative decision engine; no production page changed.
experiment.naive_method_arm: B uniform shared radical space allocation 23%
experiment.conditional_method_arm: C change full rad/right component allocation by right component density
experiment.negative_control: Script checked C and A exact SVG string identity for 灯 and 火, but the negative row displays a text note, not 4 separately rendered pixel glyphs.

verdict.assistant_visual_review: No meaningful premium/aesthetic uplift vs uniform allocation or untouched glyph seen. Characters remain largely similar textbook Hanzi Writer script; changes are mostly component x-affine rescaling, not authored professional lettering.
verdict.critical_failure: This is STILL a modest geometry-only manipulation, even if conditioned by true source-motivated structural rules. It does not solve design agency or transfer the handwriting expression of 六島.

cost: New paid software and external paid API usage: 0. Existing Figma and GitHub tools only.
stop_rules: Do not repeat changing only component ratios, endpoint widths, physical center or closed-path x-scaling; those have no demonstrated artistry.

Future work must obtain at least one designer-authored before/after change with visual ground-truth (including sketches or screenshots), enabling decisions to be inferred from actual pixel differences, not only plausible rules from text.
Implement one new full-form gesture/negative-space transformation only when supported by the designer's own before/after evidence, then test against separate unseen glyphs and user review.
If such visual evidence cannot be obtained, stop claiming designer-method reverse engineering; proceed only with scoped diagnostic and report blocker. Do not spend money without explicit approval.
